result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals within a commercial corridor. Pedestrian safety is compromised by wide curb radii and multiple driveway conflict points along the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Wide curb radii
hazards.description: Large turning radii at the intersection allow vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Multiple curb cuts
hazards.description: Frequent driveway entrances for the commercial parking lot create numerous conflict points between pedestrians and vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the commercial property

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number of driveway entrances to the commercial property to minimize conflict points.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and basic sidewalk infrastructure in a commercial setting. However, the environment is auto-oriented with wide turning radii and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals at the signalized crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners near the traffic light poles

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which encourages higher vehicle speeds during right-hand turns across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand corner adjacent to the Burger King property

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection with marked zebra crosswalks but a lack of physical pedestrian protection. The environment is heavily car-oriented, characterized by long crossing distances and a painted median that offers no physical refuge from traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance, increasing exposure time to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and center.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Refuge
hazards.description: The median is only painted, offering no physical protection or vertical barrier for pedestrians caught mid-crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway between opposing traffic lanes.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Replace the painted median with a raised concrete island to provide a safe waiting area and shorten the effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve clarity and safety for people crossing the wide intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
